reviews.text: Excellent diversity of products and services. Magnificent customer service!
Excellent location and a wide range of products. Good service. I recommend it.
Welcoming atmosphere. Very friendly employee. The dog bathing service is very thorough.
Cozy place, great variety of products and good prices....very good grooming service.

I went today for the first time for a bath and grooming. I have a blind Shih Tzu. I left work early and when I got there, the lady told me, "There's no groomer," turned her face away from me, and continued serving another customer. She said she called me, which was a lie. She didn't call to cancel. She was super rude and impolite. My dog ​​was all wet because it was raining. How can a place that takes care of animals treat an owner and their dog so rudely as this lady did?

I'm never going back.
The woman who works there is very friendly and they have all kinds of products needed for any type of domestic pet.
